**Built the lane planner (#897, slice A of #887): planLaneCommit is pure — grouping, C2 tiebreak, skip routing, ref naming; canonicalOrNull has one definition**

**What**: Added brain/scripts/memory/lane/plan.mjs (planLaneCommit) and plan.test.mjs; moved canonicalOrNull into lib/format.mjs (imported by store.mjs and split-records.mjs). The planner groups untracked record candidates by filename across worktrees, collapses byte-identical copies, resolves divergent copies by lexicographic worktree path then physical line (C2) and sets divergent only on canonical difference, routes already-on-main / modified-tracked / invalid / secret-marked candidates into skipped (never into treeEntries), names refs/heads/memory/<host>-<YYYY-MM-DD> in UTC with a validated host slug, and uses the ref tip as parent when it exists.

**Why**: Wave 3 slice 3.1a of #864 under ADR-0034 L4/C2; split from #887 at the planner seam because the combined slice forecast ~394 counted lines against the 400 budget. PR A closes #897; PR B (the shell and the collect op) closes #887.

**Where**: brain/scripts/memory/lane/plan.mjs, plan.test.mjs, lib/format.mjs, lib/store.mjs, lib/split-records.mjs; openspec/changes/issue-887-lane-collector/**.

**Learned**: a fresh cold review before push found the suite green while validateRecord's gate and the skipped sort could be deleted (unpinned), a secret-marked winner still counted as a duplicate, and a secret-marked loser was reported nowhere; all pinned or fixed. A stability test whose fixture paths share one prefix cannot detect a missing path sort; a dedicated case with basename order and path order disagreeing does. The planner no longer returns commit: the shell owns it.
